subject.title: [Bug]: Windows gateway listens but local health/status time out after Telegram polling stall (v2026.5.20)

question: Should OpenClaw escalate from repeated Telegram/channel health restart failures to a supervised Gateway process restart, and what proof threshold should gate that behavior?
rationale: Source inspection shows in-process channel and polling recovery paths, but deciding to restart the whole Gateway changes availability semantics and needs maintainer intent plus affected-host proof.

options.title: Require affected-host proof first
options.body: Keep the issue canonical and request current-main Windows diagnostics before choosing supervisor escalation or a narrower Telegram/Gateway fix.

options.title: Approve supervised recovery
options.body: Define a bounded restart threshold for repeated channel health failures and require tests/proof for normal in-process recovery and process-level escalation.

options.title: Split by subpath
options.body: Move Telegram transport, session recovery, and Gateway health timeout work into separate canonical issues only after new diagnostics show they are independently actionable.

recommendation.title: Require affected-host proof first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue canonical and request current-main Windows diagnostics before choosing supervisor escalation or a narrower Telegram/Gateway fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision centers on Gateway health/event-loop semantics and process recovery, where recent history points most strongly to vincentkoc.
